sights.address: Tebing Lane / 50 Punggol East, beside Punggol Promenade Riverside Walk, Singapore
sights.w: An Artbox-style cluster of shipping-container eateries, a roller-skating rink and plant nurseries next to the Social Innovation Park, where the Riverside Walk meets Tebing Lane's cafés — the casual evening hangout of Punggol East (Daniel Food Diary, TheSmartLocal, Little Day Out, Sassy Mama).
sights.k: Evenings; Riviera LRT exit A, then walk to the riverside

sights.address: Punggol Road / Punggol Drive / Punggol Place, Punggol, Singapore
sights.w: HDB's first eco-precinct (2010): seven 16-storey blocks with rainwater harvesting, solar-powered common areas, a wind-channelling 'eco-deck' and a community garden — the first public-housing project to win the Green Mark Platinum award, and the pilot for the Punggol eco-town.
sights.k: Residential estate — view from Punggol Drive; the eco-deck and garden are for residents

sights.address: Punggol Walk / Punggol Way / Sumang Link, along Punggol Waterway, Singapore
sights.w: Singapore's first waterfront public housing, won in an international HDB design competition by Group8asia with Aedas: stepped blocks that echo Asian rice terraces, sky terraces and roof gardens cascading down to the waterway (Waterway Terraces II is Green Mark Platinum) — published by designboom and awarded at the RTF Sustainability Awards 2016.
sights.k: Best seen from the Punggol Waterway promenade near Sumang
